scope: Exploratory functional probes preceding the 39-case registry suite; no timing or production speed claim. Archived source keeps the original .cache-relative import paths.

excludedProbe.reason: The browser acknowledged Page.setWebLifecycleState(frozen), but no freeze event fired and registry frame callbacks continued. Its printed frozen label does not establish suspension. This probe is excluded from suspension coverage.

successfulProbe.reason: A separate browser context outside the reference driver context map receives no automatic focus emulation. Freeze and resume events fire, the real timer counter remains unchanged while frozen, and it advances after activation.
